# Open Adventure CE

Colossal Cave Adventure (Will Crowther and Don Woods, 1977; Open Adventure by Eric S. Raymond) ported to the TI-84 Plus CE by DrDnar (Dr. D'nar).
Files are the unmodified release 1.8.0 from https://www.ticalc.org/pub/84plusce/asm/games/colossalcaveadventure.zip:

- ADVENT.8xp: the game
- ADVENT_data.8xv: game data (AppVar AdvenDat)
- DrSans.8xv and Times.8xv: font packs the game needs (the smaller Times_mini alternative is not included because it uses the same variable name as Times)

Licence: BSD (see LICENSE.txt). Source: https://github.com/drdnar/open-adventure-ce. Needs the CE C libraries.
